  "thinking": "Empty table, 10 minutes left. A fish has a clear outline with a telltale tail, so I'll grab the pad and sketch one before anyone starts placing dominoes.",
  "say": "Let's do a fish. Simple outline, tail on the left, and I'm sketching it on the pad now so we can see the plan before we place anything.",
  "to": "everyone",
  "eagerness": 8,
  "pad": "take",
  "sketch_clear": true,
  "sketch": [
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[4,10],[10,10],[16,10],[22,10]]},
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[10,10],[13,6],[18,5],[22,10]]},
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[10,10],[13,14],[18,15],[22,10]]},
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[4,10],[1,6]]},
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[4,10],[1,14]]},
    {"type": "label", "x": 18, "y": 9, "text": "eye"}
  ],
  "do": "continue",
  "notes": "Plan: fish facing right. Stroke 1 = spine from start at tail (4,10) to nose (22,10). Stroke 2 = top of body, stroke 3 = bottom of body, strokes 4-5 = tail fin. I hold the pad. Trace strokes 1 then 2 and 3 once someone is on stroke 1. Watch that tail lines leave the start in roughly the same direction."
